deskyard account remove: delete an account

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] account remove USER

Deletes an account with its login link, signed-in devices and the shares it
made, closing all their connections.

Arguments:
  USER       string      required  username

Options:
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -e SERVER/ENV names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard account remove anna

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
